keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Celtic 0, Besiktas 0.
Second Half begins Celtic 0, Besiktas 0.
Penalty saved. Junior Olaïtan (Besiktas) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Sam Johnstone (Celtic).
Goal! Celtic 0, Besiktas 1. Junior Olaïtan (Besiktas) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Benjamin Nygren (Celtic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Celtic. Colby Donovan replaces Jordan Lotomba.
Substitution, Celtic. Callum Osmand replaces Sebastian Tounekti.
Substitution, Celtic. Camilo Durán replaces James Forrest.
Goal! Celtic 1, Besiktas 1. Callum Osmand (Celtic) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Callum McGregor.
Substitution, Besiktas. Tiago Djaló replaces Emmanuel Agbadou.
Substitution, Besiktas. Dusan Vlahovic replaces Oh Hyeon-Gyu.
Substitution, Besiktas. Orkun Kökçü replaces Salih Özcan.
Substitution, Celtic. Haissem Hassan replaces Kasper Høgh.
Substitution, Celtic. Dane Murray replaces Cameron Carter-Vickers.
Goal! Celtic 2, Besiktas 1. Camilo Durán (Celtic) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Callum Osmand with a through ball.
Substitution, Besiktas. Ilhan Fakili replaces Václav Cerny.
Substitution, Besiktas. Ridvan Yilmaz replaces Kassoum Ouattara.
Goal! Celtic 2, Besiktas 2. Orkun Kökçü (Besiktas) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ernest Poku.
Goal! Celtic 3, Besiktas 2. Camilo Durán (Celtic) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Amir Murillo (Besiktas) is shown the yellow card.
Emirhan Topçu (Besiktas) is shown the yellow card.
